title: Jets trade Irv Charles to Seattle Seahawks, sign Younghoe Koo

sources.title: Jets trade Irv Charles to Seattle Seahawks, sign Younghoe Koo
sources.description: The Jets made a pair of transactions on Wednesday. Special teams ace Irv Charles was traded to the Seattle Seahawks in exchange for a conditional seventh round pick.
